title: Published completed Koszul fiber compared with Cech internal Hom
statement: Let X be a scheme in universe u, A a commutative ring in universe u+1, d an adic coefficient datum [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum], r a natural number, and a : Fin r -> A any finite list, including the empty list. Let S be AsSmall X.ProEt, let J be the topology induced by its canonical inverse equivalence, and let O be the pullback of the actual completed coefficient ring. Let F : D_X ≌ D(O) be the explicitly constructed derived equivalence of module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-complete, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let b_i be the global section obtained by sheafifying a_i, applying the compatible-residue scalar map and the canonical pbcCompletedComparison. For every complex C of actual completed-coefficient module sheaves, let Gamma(C), gamma_C be the explicit transported signed Koszul fiber and its (u,0) chain map [def-weil-pbc-intrinsic-completion]. There is an isomorphism e_C : F(Q Gamma(C)) ≅ RHom(C_b,F(Q C)) satisfying F(Q gamma_C) followed by e_C = eta^C_(F(Q C)), where C_b and eta^C are the actual extended Cech complex and augmentation unit [def-weil-pbc-ringed-koszul-system]. No site, ring, equivalence or scalar sections are chosen from this theorem. No generation hypothesis on a, completeness condition, or mapping universal property occurs in this comparison.

proof.text: Apply the published-fiber/strict-limit comparison to the presentation D supplied by the existing single-site Cech--Koszul comparison. This gives e from F(Q Gamma(C)) to D.completion(F(Q C)), carrying F(Q gamma_C) to D.unit.

Compose e with the inverse of theta at F(Q C). The existing unit equation eta followed by theta equals D.unit rewrites the new composite as eta followed by theta and theta inverse. Associativity and the hom/inv identity cancel these two arrows, proving precisely the displayed unit equation.

lean.statement:
theorem completed_fiber_cech_comparison
    (X : Scheme.{u}) {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A)
    (r : ℕ) (a : Fin r → A)
    (C : CochainComplex (pbcModules X (pbcAdicCompletion X d)) ℤ) :
    let O := completedCechRing X d
    let F := completedCechDerivedEquiv X d
    let b := fun i ↦ completedCechScalar X d (a i)
    ∃ e : F.functor.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (intrinsicCompletionComplex X d r a C)) ≅
        (ringedCechCompletionFunctor O (ringedExtendedCech O r b).1).obj
          (F.functor.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj C)),
      F.functor.map (DerivedCategory.Q.map (intrinsicCompletionComplexUnit X d r a C)) ≫
          e.hom =
        ringedCechCompletionUnit O (ringedExtendedCech O r b).1
          (ringedExtendedCech O r b).2 (F.functor.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj C))
